description: A workgroup teaching perimenopausal women with ADHD how to use Claude to build web projects and small agents, paired with a podcast on leadership, life, and stress management.
audience: Perimenopausal women with ADHD who lead teams and want practical, judgment-free tech skills.
notes_for_site_builders: curriculum.json is the source of truth for module names, order, slugs, and summaries — build nav and module pages from this file, not from prose in content/curriculum/.
podcast_episodes.json is the source of truth for episode listing pages — status field is one of: planned, recorded, published.

Long-form written content (full lesson text, episode scripts) lives in content/ as markdown files named after each item's slug — e.g. content/curriculum/html-basics.md matches curriculum.json's 'html-basics' module.

content/for_audience/ and content/for_host/ are NOT meant for the public site — for_audience is direct messaging to workgroup members, for_host is Jani's private prep material. Do not surface for_host/ content publicly.
This manifest itself can be treated as a stable entry point — re-fetch it before assuming the data shape, since new tracks/fields may be added over time.
